items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And I played with the Marlis S. Cadillac a little bit.

ctx.x: Was that before they had Chavez or after? No, it was, yeah, it was Julius Chavez, that's right. Oh, he was the one. Yeah.

The Melon Pickles. Yeah, the Melon Pickles. That's the band. And the drum? I used to listen to him every night over there. And the drum was pitch, you know? That was Al Domey? Yeah. Yeah. Al, well, is anything? The next time you see Al, ask him about Fazola. Yeah. And when he sees me, he says, the time I see you, I think of Fazola. Because we were always together, you know? Yeah. And he remembered that. Well, he also played at the Legion a couple of times with us. You know, Substituted? Mm-hmm. Boy, he plays a…
I never did catch a band. I keep going back and there's never any band. I'll be doing it. And with George Wagner.
